issues.title: Bank of Korea Raises Benchmark Rate to 3.25% and Lifts Next Year's Growth Forecast to 4.1%
issues.titleKo: 한국은행, 기준금리 3.25%로 인상…내년 성장률 전망 4.1%로 상향
issues.summary: The Bank of Korea raised its benchmark interest rate by 0.25 percentage point, from 3.0 percent to 3.25 percent, on the 26th. It also lifted its growth forecast for next year from 2.9 percent to 4.1 percent and left open the possibility of further increases.
issues.why: With loan rates already around 5 percent, a higher benchmark rate could raise the interest burden on variable-rate loans, which matters to university students who have loans or will take them out.

paragraphs.en: The Bank of Korea raised its benchmark interest rate from 3.0 percent to 3.25 percent on the 26th, an increase of 0.25 percentage point. The decision came at the Monetary Policy Board's final meeting of the year. It was the third increase in the second half of this year, following hikes in July and August. Five of the board's seven members voted in favor, while two argued for holding rates steady.
paragraphs.ko: 한국은행이 26일 기준금리를 연 3.0%에서 3.25%로 0.25%포인트 올렸다. 이번 결정은 금융통화위원회의 올해 마지막 회의에서 나왔다. 7월과 8월에 이은 올 하반기 세 번째 인상이다. 위원 7명 중 5명이 찬성했고 2명은 동결 의견을 냈다.

sents.ko: 한국은행이 26일 기준금리를 연 3.0%에서 3.25%로 0.25%포인트 올렸다.

sents.ko: 이번 결정은 금융통화위원회의 올해 마지막 회의에서 나왔다.

paragraphs.en: The central bank raised its growth forecast for this year from 3.3 percent to 3.9 percent, and its forecast for next year from 2.9 percent to 4.1 percent. It explained that a strong semiconductor cycle is expected to push this year's exports above $1 trillion for the first time. Consumer prices rose 2.8 percent last month, higher than the government's 2 percent target.
paragraphs.ko: 한국은행은 올해 성장률 전망을 3.3%에서 3.9%로, 내년 전망을 2.9%에서 4.1%로 높였다. 반도체 경기가 좋아 올해 수출액이 처음으로 1조 달러를 넘길 것이라고 설명했다. 지난달 소비자물가 상승률은 2.8%로 정부 목표인 2%보다 높았다.

He cited strengthening growth, inflation expected to stay above the target for a long time and remaining financial stability risks. The bank also pointed to the prolonged war in the Middle East, which is keeping international oil prices high. It added that rising incomes from the semiconductor boom could revive consumption and push prices up further. Household credit reached 2,030.5 trillion won at the end of the third quarter this year.

issues.title: Railway Union Begins Safe-Operation Action as 235 Metropolitan Trains Run 20 Minutes or More Late
issues.titleKo: 철도노조 안전운행 투쟁 첫날, 광역전철 235대 20분 이상 지연
issues.summary: The Korean Railway Workers' Union began a safe-operation action at 9 a.m. on the 26th, set to last through Dec. 4. By 5 p.m. on the first day, 235 metropolitan trains were delayed by 20 minutes or more and four conventional trains had been suspended.
issues.why: Weekend trips overlap with university essay-exam and interview schedules at this time of year, so anyone planning to travel by train should check service status in advance.

paragraphs.en: The Korean Railway Workers' Union began a safe-operation action at 9 a.m. on the 26th. The industrial action demands better promotion rules, additional allowances and more staff, and it is scheduled to continue until Dec. 4. The union plans to launch an indefinite general strike at 9 a.m. on Dec. 10 if its demands are not met.
paragraphs.ko: 전국철도노동조합이 26일 오전 9시부터 안전운행 투쟁을 시작했다. 승진 제도 개선, 추가 수당 지급, 인력 확충을 요구하는 쟁의행위로, 12월 4일까지 이어질 예정이다. 노조는 요구가 받아들여지지 않으면 12월 10일 오전 9시부터 무기한 총파업에 들어가겠다는 계획이다.

sents.ko: 전국철도노동조합이 26일 오전 9시부터 안전운행 투쟁을 시작했다.

sents.en: The industrial action demands better promotion rules, additional allowances and more staff, and it is scheduled to continue until Dec. 4.
sents.ko: 승진 제도 개선, 추가 수당 지급, 인력 확충을 요구하는 쟁의행위로, 12월 4일까지 이어질 예정이다.

sents.en: The union plans to launch an indefinite general strike at 9 a.m. on Dec. 10 if its demands are not met.

paragraphs.en: Unlike a strike, in which work stops, a safe-operation action involves following work rules and operating regulations to the letter. Drivers do not speed up to make up for lost time, and they also refuse to work overtime or on holidays. If a vehicle problem is found during pre-departure checks, the train is not sent out.
paragraphs.ko: 안전운행 투쟁은 업무를 멈추는 파업과 달리 작업 수칙과 운행 규정을 빠짐없이 지키는 방식이다. 기관사들은 지연된 시간을 만회하려고 속도를 높이는 회복 운전을 하지 않고 시간 외·휴일 근무도 거부한다. 출고 전 점검에서 차량 이상이 발견되면 열차를 내보내지 않는다.

issues.title: Constitutional Court Rules Blanket Ban on Foreigners' Political Activity in Immigration Act Incompatible With Constitution
issues.titleKo: 헌재, 외국인 정치활동 전면 금지한 출입국관리법에 헌법불합치
issues.summary: The Constitutional Court on the 26th issued a decision of nonconformity to the Constitution on Article 17, Paragraph 2 of the Immigration Control Act, which in principle bans foreigners from political activity. The National Assembly must amend the law by Dec. 31, 2028.
issues.why: The ruling could change the scope of free expression for international students studying in Korea, so it also touches the diverse friends found on campus.

paragraphs.en: The Constitutional Court on the 26th ruled on a constitutional complaint filed by two Mongolian international students. It issued a decision of nonconformity to the Constitution on Article 17, Paragraph 2 of the Immigration Control Act. Six of the nine justices found the provision unconstitutional, while three found it constitutional. The provision says foreigners must not engage in political activity except in cases set by law. It was created in 1977 and came under the court's review for the first time in 49 years.
paragraphs.ko: 헌법재판소는 26일 몽골 국적 유학생 2명이 낸 헌법소원을 판단했다. 출입국관리법 17조 2항에 헌법불합치 결정을 했다. 재판관 9명 중 6명이 위헌, 3명이 합헌 의견이었다. 이 조항은 외국인이 법에서 정한 경우를 빼고는 정치활동을 해서는 안 된다고 규정한다. 1977년 생긴 이 조항은 49년 만에 헌재 판단을 받았다.

sents.en: The Constitutional Court on the 26th ruled on a constitutional complaint filed by two Mongolian international students.

issues.title: Schools, Universities and Test Operators Scramble to Tighten Exam Supervision Against AI Cheating
issues.titleKo: AI 부정행위 막으려 시험 감독 강화, 학교·대학·자격시험 현장 분주
issues.summary: Supervision of middle and high school exams is being raised to the level of the college entrance exam to stop cheating with AI devices, and schools are scrambling to secure equipment and staff. Jeju National University, the TOEIC and the teacher appointment exam have also decided to add proctors or strengthen checks.
issues.why: For university students facing final exams and tests such as the TOEIC, belongings checks and supervision methods could change, so this directly concerns them.

paragraphs.en: On the 24th, the Ministry of Education reported a plan to counter cheating with smart devices to a Cabinet meeting. The plan raises the management and supervision of middle and high school exams to the level of the college entrance exam. The core of the plan is to place two or more chief and assistant proctors in each exam room and check every student with a metal detector. On the 26th, the Gyeonggi Provincial Office of Education sent this guideline to schools in the province. It added that schools should get consent for the checks from students and parents in advance and print a warning on exam papers.
paragraphs.ko: 교육부는 24일 스마트기기 부정행위 대응 방안을 국무회의에 보고했다. 이 방안은 중·고교 내신 시험장 관리·감독을 수능 수준으로 강화하는 내용이다. 시험실에 정·부감독 2인 이상을 두고 금속탐지기로 전수검사하는 것이 핵심이다. 경기도교육청은 26일 이 지침을 도내 학교에 안내했다. 학생·학부모에게 검사 동의를 미리 받고 시험지에 경고 문구를 넣으라는 내용도 더했다.

paragraphs.en: Schools say the preparation is a burden. A high school teacher in Gyeonggi Province said all of next week's training for exam supervisors must be rewritten. The teacher added that metal detectors are in short supply because there are more than 900 first- and second-year students. The Ministry of Education plans to buy about 12,000 more metal detectors by early next month, raising the national stock from about 8,300 to about 20,000. Still, with 36,621 first- and second-year high school classes last year, that falls short of one per class. The Seoul Metropolitan Office of Education said it would buy about 8,300 for its 319 high schools to supply one per class.

issues.summary: The Office of the U.S. Trade Representative announced on the 25th that it will keep the tariff cap on South Korea at 15 percent, as previously agreed. However, it cited Korea's industrial policies, including semiconductor clusters, as a cause of overproduction and said it could raise the rate to 25 percent if implementation of the deal goes awry.
issues.why: The tariff level and U.S. pressure over industrial policy could affect the outlook for key export sectors such as semiconductors and cars, which is no small matter for students eyeing jobs in those fields.

paragraphs.en: On the 25th, local time, the Office of the U.S. Trade Representative (USTR) announced the results of its Section 301 investigation into overproduction. It also announced proposed tariffs on several economies, including South Korea, Japan and the European Union. For South Korea, it proposed a tariff cap of 15 percent, in line with the existing Korea-U.S. agreement. This means that the existing most-favored-nation tariff, the forced labor tariff imposed in July and the new overproduction tariff together will not exceed 15 percent.

issues.summary: South Korea's 5G network is moving to standalone (SA) mode, running on 5G alone without an LTE network, seven years after its commercial launch. LG Uplus will start nationwide service on Nov. 30 and SK Telecom on Dec. 1.
issues.why: It is worth checking whether your 5G smartphone is supported and noting that the rollout will widen in stages through the end of next year, so the news is close to home for college students.

paragraphs.en: The Ministry of Science and ICT and the three mobile carriers held a ceremony on the 26th in Seoul. The event at the Korea Chamber of Commerce and Industry marked the nationwide commercial launch of standalone 5G. KT introduced the service first in 2021, and LG Uplus will begin on Nov. 30, followed by SK Telecom on Dec. 1. Last year, the government made the switch to standalone mode mandatory within this year as a condition of reallocating spectrum.

issues.summary: The number of people billed for this year's housing comprehensive real estate tax reached 726,000, up 34.5 percent from last year. Sharp rises in Seoul home prices and official prices drove the increase, and both the number of single-home households billed and the amount billed climbed steeply.
issues.why: Because rising official prices can bring even someone who owns just one home under the tax, the news shows how home prices and holding-tax burdens touch everyday life.

paragraphs.en: The Ministry of Finance and Economy announced the 2026 comprehensive real estate tax notices on the 26th. The number of people billed for the housing portion of the tax reached 726,000, up 34.5 percent from 540,000 last year. The total billed rose 35.3 percent to 2.3 trillion won. The average bill per individual rose 24.1 percent, from 1.606 million won last year to 1.994 million won.

issues.title: Constitutional Court Strikes Down Ban on Third-Party Intervention in Labor Disputes After 36 Years
issues.titleKo: 헌재, 쟁의행위 제3자 개입 금지 조항 36년 만에 위헌 결정
issues.summary: The Constitutional Court ruled on the 26th that provisions of the former Labor Dispute Adjustment Act and Trade Union Act banning and punishing third-party intervention in labor disputes are unconstitutional. The decision reverses rulings from 1990 and 1993 that upheld them, after more than 30 years.
issues.why: The ruling confirms that workers' right to seek outside help in asserting their rights is among the three labor rights protected by the Constitution, which matters to college students about to enter the job market.

paragraphs.en: The Constitutional Court ruled on the 26th that two provisions are unconstitutional. They are the main text of Article 13-2 of the former Labor Dispute Adjustment Act and Article 12-2 of the former Trade Union Act. The provisions punishing violations of those articles were also struck down. In both cases, six justices found the provisions unconstitutional and three found them constitutional. The provisions barred third parties, who are neither labor nor management, from manipulating, inciting or obstructing labor disputes or collective bargaining, and punished those who violated the ban.
paragraphs.ko: 헌법재판소는 26일 두 조항이 헌법에 어긋난다고 결정했다. 옛 노동쟁의조정법 제13조의2 본문과 옛 노동조합법 제12조의2 본문이다. 이를 어긴 사람을 처벌하는 조항도 마찬가지로 위헌이라고 했다. 두 사건 모두 재판관 6명은 위헌, 3명은 합헌 의견을 냈다. 이 조항들은 쟁의행위나 단체교섭 때 노사 당사자가 아닌 제3자가 조종·선동·방해하는 것을 막고, 어기면 처벌하는 내용이었다.

paragraphs.en: The ruling stemmed from a retrial of people who were convicted after supporting the 1991 Daewoo Shipbuilding union strike. A man surnamed Yoon, a former head of the Daewoo Precision union, and former lawmaker Hong Young-pyo belonged to a union solidarity group. They helped the strike, for example by issuing a joint statement. Although they did not work for Daewoo Shipbuilding, they were sentenced to prison in 1991 for violating the ban on third-party intervention. The two requested a retrial in 2022, 31 years later, and the Seoul Central District Court handling the retrial asked the Constitutional Court to rule on the constitutionality.

paragraphs.en: The provisions were created in 1980 by the Legislative Council for National Security under Chun Doo-hwan's new military junta. They effectively lost force in 1997 when the Labor Dispute Adjustment Act and the Trade Union Act were repealed and the current Trade Union Act took effect. They were fully deleted in a 2006 law revision. Justices Jeong Hyeong-sik, Kim Bok-hyeong and Cho Han-chang dissented. issues.title: Capital Region to Recruit Residents for 56,000 Public Homes Next Year, Up 44% From This Year
issues.titleKo: 내년 수도권 공공주택 5만6000가구 입주자 모집, 올해보다 44% 늘어
issues.summary: The Ministry of Land, Infrastructure and Transport said it will recruit residents for 56,000 public homes in the capital region next year, made up of 35,000 public sale units and 21,000 public rental units. That is double the average annual volume of the past five years, and the ministry also announced support measures such as purchase commitments for unsold units on private land.
issues.why: Public sale and rental homes are meant to ease housing insecurity for people without homes, so the size and timing of recruitment are useful for college students and young workers who need to find housing.

paragraphs.en: The Ministry of Land, Infrastructure and Transport held its fourth regular housing supply briefing at the Government Complex Seoul on the 26th. It unveiled its plan to recruit residents for public housing in the capital region next year. It will include 35,000 public sale units and 21,000 public rental units, for a total of 56,000. Recruitment in the capital region rose from 12,000 units in 2023 to 27,000 last year and 39,000 this year (provisional). Next year's volume is 44 percent higher than this year's.
paragraphs.ko: 국토교통부는 26일 정부서울청사에서 제4차 주택공급 정례브리핑을 열었다. 이 자리에서 내년 수도권 공공주택 입주자 모집 계획을 밝혔다. 공공분양 3만 5000가구와 공공임대 2만 1000가구로 모두 5만 6000가구이다. 수도권 모집 물량은 2023년 1만 2000가구에서 지난해 2만 7000가구, 올해 3만 9000가구(잠정)로 늘었다. 내년 물량은 올해보다 44% 많다.

issues.summary: An analysis by Jinhak found that the rush of top-grade natural sciences applicants to medical schools eased from a year earlier. The share of the same group applying to semiconductor contract programs rose from 7.3 percent to 16.3 percent.
issues.why: The data shows how application patterns among top-tier students have shifted between medical schools and semiconductor contract programs, which is useful for students preparing for college admissions.

paragraphs.en: Jinhak compared early admission application data for the 2026 and 2027 academic years and found that medical school fever among top-grade natural sciences students has cooled. The average number of applications per medical school applicant fell from 4.49 to 4.27. Medical schools' share of all applications dropped 6.5 percentage points, from 73.6 percent to 67.1 percent.
paragraphs.ko: 진학사가 2026학년도와 2027학년도 수시 지원 데이터를 비교한 결과 자연계열 내신 1등급대 수험생의 의대 쏠림이 줄었다. 의대 지원자 1인당 평균 지원 건수는 4.49건에서 4.27건으로 줄었다. 전체 지원 건수 중 의대 비중은 73.6%에서 67.1%로 6.5%포인트 낮아졌다.

issues.title: Korea to Raise Prepaid Balance Cap to Up to 5 Million Won for First Time in 18 Years
issues.summary: The Financial Services Commission unveiled a plan on the 26th to raise the prepaid electronic payment balance cap from 2 million won to between 3 million and 5 million won, depending on the identity verification method. It also introduces a daily usage limit and allows foreign tourists to load up to 3 million won.
issues.why: Because both the balance cap and a new daily usage limit are changing, college students who often use easy payments and money transfers may find the way they use them changing.

paragraphs.en: The Financial Services Commission held a briefing on improving the prepaid electronic payment system at the Korea Federation of Banks in Seoul on the 26th. The meeting was chaired by Commission Chairman Lee Eog-weon, who unveiled the reform plan. The balance cap will rise to 3 million won if users link a deposit account to verify their identity. It will rise to as much as 5 million won if users pass non-face-to-face real-name verification and the prepaid provider's security level is sufficient. The cap for anonymous accounts is 500,000 won.

issues.summary: Kim Do-yeong of the KIA Tigers won his second regular-season MVP award at the 2026 KBO Awards on the 26th. He said he will somehow succeed in his challenge of moving from third base to shortstop next year.
issues.why: The news names this season's top player and previews a new challenge for next year, giving college students who follow Korean pro baseball something to watch in the coming season.

paragraphs.en: Kim Do-yeong, 23, of the KIA Tigers was named MVP at the 2026 Shinhan SOL KBO Awards on the 26th. The ceremony was held at the Crystal Ballroom of Lotte Hotel World in Songpa District, Seoul. He received 80 of 136 valid votes, or 58.8 percent, ahead of Kwak Bin of the Doosan Bears, who got 34. It is his second MVP award after 2024.
